tail: Lessons from earlier runs:
- [plan] A successful task branch push does not satisfy this runner's publication check.
- [plan] A successful feature-branch push did not satisfy this legacy workflow's main-branch delivery check.
- [plan] A successful production build and HTTP 200 do not alone prove the shelf remains usable after hydration.
- [plan] Two referenced standing-rule files are not present in this repository checkout.
- [plan] Use tolerance for exponential-filter assertions even at subnormal frame durations.

- [repo:otohime] Include a recognized top-level path (e.g. scripts/ or projects/<plan>/task-N-evidence.md) in SWE task interfaces when touching Next.js app/(site)/ route groups, and use schema='platform.plan-prerequisites.v1' in prerequisites.
- [global] plan-manager ci-gates (tests/run_gates.py) fails 'empty package expansion' when the cwd is reached through a symlink, e.g. a fleet lease's /home/.../build-worker -> /data/build-worker

- [global] A red root pipeline's surviving service child can deploy long after a newer green pipeline and silently roll that service back (last writer wins). Compare the live image tag with the newest successful deploy job, not only the pin env.

- [global] Moving a page to TanStack Query with a production retry of 1 silently absorbs a one-shot injected fault, so the "failed next page keeps what is loaded" e2e went red. Also, /media/ e2e/signed-out.spec.ts called page.getByLabelText, which does not exist in Playwright, so that spec could never pass; it was outside every named gate.

- [global] Blender's FBX importer silently drops location keys on child bones it auto-connects, and a required media-generator test was a wall-clock time bomb that broke the 3d-animation gate on main at 2026-10-29T00:00Z
- [global] A decider answer that approves a replan does not perform the replan: no task is inserted, and the blocked task is relaunched with the same contract
- [global] A test another plan adds to gameplay-studio internal/api without a batch manifest entry turns every later studio gate red

- [global] A native check's raw output is kept only as artifact_digest = sha256(json(raw)), but for go test it can often be recovered: re-run at the immutable SHA, then search the single 'ok <pkg> <t>s' timing line.

- [global] scripts/gameplay/require-js-tests.mjs exited 0 without running anything whenever the checkout path held a space, e.g. a macOS fleet lease under 'Application Support'. Its guard compared import.meta.url, which encodes a space as %20, with a raw `file://${argv[1]}`. Every REQUIRE_JS make gate (vitest and Playwright) was therefore a silent no-op there. Fixed in 4827bc713. If a gate prints no test output and no 'require-js-tests: ok' line, it did not run.
- [global] A pkgver release cut before git-push-safe rebases keeps a source_sha that is not on main. pkgver check still passes because it compares the tree hash, and the tree matched.

- [global] A batched replan leaves the superseded revision's live batch (bat-3, 'verifying') holding its repo delivery lock. The next revision's integration permit is then refused delivery_lock_contended, with no AI run and no escalation.
